# Topic Log

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A chronological record of what actually happened related to a topic.

## Scope note

Captures events about a topic with timestamps as they occur: factual, not interpretive.

## Broader

- [Topic Cluster](../TopicCluster/)
